--- stderr (tail) ---
Usage: vibe-test [options] [command]

AI-powered browser testing agent — reads your code, tests your product

Options:
  -V, --version             output the version number
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  run [options] [url]       Run vibe tests against a URL
  converge [options] [url]  Iterative coverage: baseline run, then follow-up
                            rounds from gaps + failures until thresholds (or
                            max rounds)
  init [options]            Set up Vibe Test — auto-detects editors (Cursor,
                            Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, Roo Code) and
                            configures all of them globally + per-project
  reset                     Delete .vibe in the current project (memory, intel,
                            screenshots) for a fresh test run
  report                    Open the last test report in your browser
  help [command]            display help for command
